mechanism_narrative: A sustained recovery in WORKPLACES mobility from -53.1 to -28.0 signals a return to commuting routines that lifts weekday retail footfall, producing higher RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days while WORKPLACES continues to rise or stays above -30.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in GROCERY_PHARM mobility from +3.6 to -6.0 indicates reduced essential out-of-home activity, which predicts lower RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks as households stay home.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days while GROCERY_PHARM continues to decline.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT mobility falls below -55 for two consecutive weeks, it signals intensified mobility restrictions that suppress non-essential trips, driving RETAIL_REC lower over the following two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean falls below -55 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 14 days despite TRANSIT staying below -55 for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction of a sharp WORKPLACES rebound and a RESIDENTIAL decline signals people leaving home for work and leisure, which jointly boost RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises > 20 points week-on-week while RESIDENTIAL falls
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC falls over the next 28 days when WORKPLACES rises >20 points week-on-week and RESIDENTIAL falls simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening-restrictions regime, a PARKS mobility drop below -10 indicates reduced outdoor activity and stricter confinement, which spills over to lower RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 14 days while PARKS stays below -10 in a tightening-restrictions regime.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated RESIDENTIAL mobility above +7 means more time spent at home and less time in retail settings, predicting a lower RETAIL_REC over the next week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 7 days while RESIDENTIAL remains above +7.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction of declining GROCERY_PHARM and very low TRANSIT signals broad suppression of out-of-home activity under restrictions, which drives RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM falls below -4 while TRANSIT below -55
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days when GROCERY_PHARM is below -4 and TRANSIT is below -55 simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: Seasonal January retail contraction, visible in RETAIL_REC falling from -14.4 to -22.6, dominates the partial WORKPLACES recovery, keeping RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks than over the last four weeks.
